title: LIVE UPDATES: First BARMM parliamentary elections
summary: Bookmark and refresh this page for the latest news, photos, videos, and analyses as Rappler closely follows the historic elections

blocks.text: The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao is holding its first parliamentary elections on September 14, 2026, after being postponed at least four times: first in May 2022, then in May 2025, October 2025, and again in March 2026.

The historic polls are seen as a pivotal moment in the decades-long peace process in a region that was mired in conflict and socioeconomic and political challenges. The upcoming elections are also a test for the Bangsamoro transition and the institutions and systems established in the last seven years.

blocks.text: 23 hours ago
After long-awaited BARMM polls, voters look ahead with hope

Across the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), voters went to the polls on Monday, September 14, carrying two things with them: the memory of how elections had gone before, and the hope that this one could be different.
Sep 16, 2026 8:44 PM PHT
Party leaders to negotiate coalition in BARMM Parliament
After the historic polls on Monday, September 14, the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) is now facing a hung parliament.
BARMM Interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua said a coalition with other parties is an “unavoidable situation” to establish a government.
Sep 16, 2026 4:11 PM PHT
Rappler Recap: Coalition likely as race for BARMM chief minister begins

With no clear majority hold over the Bangsamoro Parliament, the race to form coalitions among political parties begins as the top seat of chief minister remains vacant. Rappler’s Iya Gozum and John Sitchon report.

blocks.text: Sep 15, 2026 7:38 PM PHT
Coalition in new BARMM gov’t ‘unavoidable,’ says Macacua

BARMM Interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua said a coalition with other parties is “an unavoidable situation” to complete the majority of 41 members in parliament. Macacua was proclaimed Maguindanao del Norte 3rd District representative on Tuesday, September 15.

Macacua proclaimed Maguindanao del Norte 3rd District representative
BARMM Interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua proclaimed as Maguindanao del Norte 3rd District representative on Tuesday, September 15.
Sep 15, 2026 6:11 PM PHT
Mastura: BARMM gov’t to work on coalition basis

Bangsamoro Member of Parliament-elect Ishak Mastura says the three biggest parties in the region may coalesce to form the government of the day. “Otherwise, we’ll have a hung parliament,” Mastura of Maguindanao del Norte’s 5th parliamentary district said Tuesday, September 15.
Mastura says tensions between regional political parties “will eventually die down in due time.”
